story.iWant: implement a Silver IOManager for processed data persistence
story.soThat: extracted content and summaries are properly managed with content-type awareness
story.tasks: - Task 1: Create SilverIOManager class structure - Add SilverIOManager class to dagster_project/resources/io_managers.py - Define class inheriting from Dagster IOManager base - Import required types (IOManager, OutputContext, InputContext) - Initialize silver layer directories (extracted_content/, summaries/) - Task 2: Implement extracted content storage - Implement _handle_output_extracted_content() method - Support both HTML and video content types - Generate full SHA256 hash from URL for filename - Include created_at and updated_at timestamps (ISO 8601) - Add lineage metadata: source_asset, source_hash, transformation_timestamp - Write to artifacts/silver/extracted_content/{hash}.json - Implement _load_input_extracted_content() for deserialization - Handle file-not-found errors gracefully - Task 3: Implement summary storage with dual-format output - Implement _handle_output_summary() method - Generate full SHA256 hash from URL for filename - Include created_at and updated_at timestamps - Add lineage metadata (source_asset, source_hash, transformation_timestamp) - Write JSON format to artifacts/silver/summaries/{hash}.json - Generate markdown format and write to artifacts/silver/summaries/{hash}.md - Markdown includes: title, URL, summary content, metadata footer - Handle both success and failure summaries in markdown - Implement _load_input_summary() for deserialization - Handle missing files and corrupted JSON gracefully - Task 4: Implement IOManager handle_output and load_input dispatch - Implement handle_output() method with content type detection - Dispatch to appropriate handler (extracted content vs summary) - Implement load_input() method with content type detection - Dispatch to appropriate loader based on asset type - Add structlog logging for all I/O operations - Task 5: Unit tests for SilverIOManager - Create test file: tests/test_silver_io_manager_unit.py - Test extracted content storage for HTML type - Test extracted content storage for video type - Test summary storage in both JSON and markdown formats - Test SHA256 hash generation consistency - Test created_at and updated_at timestamp presence (ISO 8601) - Test lineage metadata structure and completeness - Test error handling for missing files - Test metadata preservation across save/load cycle - Use pytest fixtures for temp directories (tmp_path) - Task 6: Integration test for file storage - Create test file: tests/integration/test_silver_io_manager.py - Test end-to-end extracted content storage (HTML type) - Test end-to-end extracted content storage (video type) - Test end-to-end summary storage with dual-format output - Verify files created in correct silver subdirectories - Verify full SHA256 hash used in filenames - Verify both .json and .md files exist for summaries - Verify metadata completeness (timestamps, lineage) - Mark with @pytest.mark.integration

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: AC1: SilverIOManager class created in dagster_project/resources/io_managers.py - Class exists and is importable AC2: Handles storage of extracted content (HTML and video types) - Unit tests verify both content types AC3: Handles storage of summaries in both JSON and markdown formats - Unit tests verify dual-format output AC4: Uses full SHA256 hash for filename generation - File naming verified in tests AC5: Includes created_at and updated_at timestamps in all artifacts - Metadata includes ISO 8601 timestamps AC6: Supports data lineage metadata (source asset references, transformation timestamps) - Unit tests verify lineage structure AC7: Unit tests verify content-type handling and metadata preservation - Unit tests pass for all content types AC8: Integration test verifies file storage and retrieval for both content types - Integration test passes end-to-end

doc.title: Architecture Documentation - Medallion Architecture
doc.snippet: Silver layer stores processed, application-ready data with business logic applied. Includes extracted_content/ and summaries/ subdirectories. Data flow: bronze → silver transformation with lineage tracking.

doc.title: Story 1.1: Define Bronze and Silver Layer Structure
doc.snippet: Silver directories created: artifacts/silver/extracted_content/, artifacts/silver/summaries/. Asset naming convention: {layer}_{data_type}. Full SHA256 hashing for all filenames (64 chars).

story-context.constraints: - MUST extend existing dagster_project/resources/io_managers.py file (add SilverIOManager class alongside BronzeIOManager) - MUST use full SHA256 hash (64 chars) for all filenames - NO truncation to [:16] - MUST include created_at AND updated_at timestamps in ISO 8601 format (datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()) - MUST include lineage metadata object with: source_asset, source_hash, transformation_timestamp - MUST generate both .json AND .md files for summaries (same hash basename) - MUST use structlog for all logging - NO print statements - MUST handle both content types: extracted content (HTML/video) and summaries (success/failure) - MUST use pathlib.Path for file operations - MUST use context managers (with statement) for file I/O - MUST pass make check (format, lint, typecheck, test) - NO docstrings (per CLAUDE.md constitution) - Integration tests MUST be marked with @pytest.mark.integration

tests.standards: Testing follows pytest framework with unit and integration test separation. Unit tests use tmp_path fixture for isolation and test serialization/deserialization logic. Integration tests use @pytest.mark.integration marker and verify actual file creation in real directories (artifacts/silver/). All tests must pass before story completion. Code must pass make check (format, lint, typecheck, test). Test naming convention: test_{functionality}_description. Follow BronzeIOManager test patterns from Story 1.2.
